response.title: which power station runs a reptile heat lamp the longest in a power outage
response.answer:
For keeping a reptile heat lamp running during a power outage, the best power station is one with a large battery capacity (Wh), high inverter efficiency, and expandable batteries.

My top choices are EcoFlow DELTA Pro Ultra, EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3, and Anker SOLIX F3800. All three can run a typical reptile heat lamp for much longer than small portable power stations.

The important thing is that a 100W heat lamp uses about 2.4 kWh per day if it runs continuously. That means even a large battery can be drained in a couple of days.

Which power station lasts longest?

Here is a comparison assuming one heat lamp runs continuously, with approximately 85% usable battery energy after AC conversion losses.

A ceramic heat emitter or deep heat projector may be preferable for nighttime heating because it doesn't produce visible light, but its wattage still determines battery consumption.

Two questions to narrow down the best option
